title: Engine vendor catalog (D-069 item 7)
description: Every vendor the engine (scripts/) may call: how a call to it is recognized, the adapter modules that may make it, the ports that may load those adapters, and the shrink-only baseline of call sites outside its adapters. Read by scripts/lib/vendor_check.py.

status.description: active has adapters; slot has none yet; forbidden never gets one.

endpoints.description: Host names or API path fragments; a string that contains one is a call.

clis.description: Command names; running one is a call.

modules.description: Python modules or JavaScript packages that are the vendor's client; importing one (or naming its .py file in shell) is a call.

adapters.description: Files that may make any call to the vendor.

selectors.description: Ports that may import the vendor's adapter modules to select them, and nothing else.

baseline.description: path:token of each call outside the adapters that predates the check; the list only shrinks.

baseline_classification.description: Nature and reason for retaining each baseline site, keyed by the unchanged path:token identity. Completeness is enforced by vendor_check; optional here for additive v1 compatibility.
